run_voc_evaluation: run PASCAL VOC evaluation on object detection predictions against ground truth boxlists
eval_detection_voc: evaluate object detection predictions against ground truth using configurable IoU threshold and VOC metric
calc_detection_voc_prec_rec: calculate precision and recall for object detection predictions using PASCAL VOC matching logic
calc_detection_voc_ap: calculate average precision from precision and recall arrays using 11-point or interpolated metric
review_voc_eval: review the PASCAL VOC evaluation functions for object detection precision recall and average precision
